title: 3.3.3.0-dev-b (9cf7) constantly freezes
body:
Again in this week application froze. Clearing local cache stopping application rebooting phone did not brought anything. 
Reinstalled application also no help. 
Using Android 15 with play protect turned off. 
Using equil pump from 2025. 
Any help appreciated.

comments.body: I've switched between xdrip bg delivery to tomato. Restarted phone started aaps and changed back to xdrip. Started working. Weird pretty much. I do not use xdrip but juggluco which provides the BG readings. Hope in the future when it will reoccur same way will help.
